Text.DESC_COMMON: A blizzard strikes the selected area, damaging the target and all stacks on adjacent hexes.
Text.INVISIBILITY_BODY:
Hides a selected friendly stack from enemy attention. Enemies rarely choose it as a target.

Movement, an incoming attack or an outgoing attack removes the effect. Waiting and defending do not remove it.

Lasts a number of rounds equal to the hero's Spell Power.
Text.WASP_SWARM_BODY: Sends a swarm of stinging wasps against a selected enemy stack. Half the damage is dealt immediately; the remaining half is dealt at the start of the next round, after which the swarm disappears.
Text.TSUNAMI_BODY: Unleashes a devastating wave against all enemy stacks. Friendly troops take no damage.
Text.WASP_SWARM_STATUS:
{Wasp Swarm}

The swarm deals its remaining damage at the start of the next round, then the effect ends.
Text.DEEP_FREEZE_BODY: Deals heavy damage to a selected stack and freezes it completely for 3 rounds. The frozen stack skips its turn, cannot retaliate and has 0 Speed. The first attack that actually deals damage shatters the ice after dealing damage. The first physical hit deals double damage; Fire spells deal 150% damage and other damaging spells deal 50%.
Text.HEAVENLY_WRATH_BODY: Strikes a selected stack with a powerful discharge. If the surviving target has not yet acted, it loses its remaining turn in the current round.
Text.CATACLYSM_BODY: Shakes the entire battlefield and damages all ground creatures in both armies. Flying creatures take no damage.
Text.CATACLYSM_STUN_BODY_H3: Each ground stack that has not yet acted has a 20% chance to lose its turn in the current round. Friendly stacks have a 5% chance.
Text.DRAGON_WRATH_BODY: Increases the Defense of a selected friendly stack. Only one target per side can have this effect. Enemies prefer to attack it when a legal attack is possible.
Text.INSPIRATION_BODY: Grants a selected living friendly stack one additional activation immediately after the current stack finishes its turn. The target retains its normal turn in this round.
Text.HEAVEN_SHIELD_BODY: Makes the target immune to physical damage for 2 rounds. Magical damage is unaffected.
Text.EREDAR_RAGE_BODY: Doubles a selected friendly stack's direct damage for two full activations. Retaliation also deals double damage but does not consume an activation.
Text.SUMMON_PHOENIX_BODY:
Summons one Phoenix on a free position on your half of the battlefield. On death or replacement, it releases Inferno in a radius of 2 hexes.

Health and damage depend primarily on the hero's level, with faster growth after level 50. Spell Power and Fire Magic strengthen the summon; the army contribution is limited.

A repeated cast replaces the previous Phoenix. Costs 25 mana up to hero level 10, then +1 mana per level.
Text.SUMMON_PHOENIX_BODY_LEGACY: Summons one Phoenix. Its health and damage depend on the hero's level, Spell Power, the number of living creatures in the regular army and Fire Magic. A repeated cast replaces the previous Phoenix. Costs 25 mana up to hero level 10, then +1 mana per level.
Text.SUMMON_PHOENIX_BODY_ARMY_HP: Summons one Phoenix. Its health depends on the hero's level, Spell Power, the total health of the living regular army and Fire Magic. Damage depends on the hero's level and Spell Power, with a smaller contribution from the regular army. A repeated cast replaces the previous Phoenix. Costs 25 mana up to hero level 10, then +1 mana per level.
Text.BARRIER_BODY: Covers a selected area with living roots, creating an impassable barrier. The roots last several rounds and can be destroyed by attacks and spells.
Text.INCINERATION_BODY: Burns a selected enemy stack. Half the total damage is dealt immediately; the remaining half is dealt in three parts at the start of subsequent rounds. Recasting replaces the remaining effect.
Text.DRAGON_WRATH_BODY_H3: Increases the Defense of a selected friendly stack. While the spell lasts, enemies prefer to attack this stack.
Text.INSPIRATION_BODY_H3: Inspires troops on the battlefield, bringing their next activation forward.
Text.HEAVEN_SHIELD_BODY_H3: Protects a selected stack from all physical damage. Removes Anti-Magic and can be removed by Anti-Magic.
Text.EREDAR_RAGE_BODY_H3: Doubles a selected friendly stack's damage for its next two turns. Retaliation also deals double damage and does not shorten the effect.
Text.INCINERATION_BODY_H3: Burns a selected enemy stack. Half the total damage is dealt immediately; the remainder is dealt at the start of the next three rounds. Recasting replaces the remaining effect.
Text.TELEKINESIS_BODY_H3: Moves an enemy stack within 6 hexes, bypassing walls and other obstacles.
Text.CONFUSION_BODY_H3: Confuses enemy warriors, preventing them from retaliating.
Text.CONFUSION_SINGLE_H3: The selected enemy stack cannot retaliate.
Text.CONFUSION_MASS_H3: All eligible enemy stacks cannot retaliate.
Text.CONFUSION_DURATION_H3: Duration equals the hero's Spell Power.
Text.CONFUSION_STATUS_DESCRIPTION:
{Confusion}

The stack is confused and cannot retaliate.
Text.RESTORATION_BODY_H3: Restores machines and golems. Elementals can be restored only after the corresponding Wizard Academy course has been learned.
Text.INSPIRATION_LIMIT_ALL: Creatures of any level are eligible.
Text.DEEP_FREEZE_DEBUFF_DESCRIPTION:
{Deep Freeze}

The stack is frozen: 0 Speed, skips its turn and cannot retaliate. The first hit that actually deals damage receives the freeze modifier and then shatters the ice.
Text.DRAGON_WRATH_STATUS_DESCRIPTION:
{Dragon Wrath}

The stack gains Defense and becomes a preferred target for enemy AI.
Text.TEXT_95: hits or when its duration ends.
Text.TEXT_97: Summons an elemental Ice Dragon at a random position on your side of the battlefield.
Text.TEXT_99: Unleashes the power of all four elements against a selected enemy stack.
Text.SUMMON_PHOENIX_ABILITIES: Non-living. Occupies two hexes. Flies. Attacks three targets. No enemy retaliation. Fire Shield. Immune to Fire and Mind spells. Fearless. Releases Inferno on death or replacement.
Text.SUMMON_ICE_ABILITIES: Non-living. Occupies two hexes. Immune to Water and Mind spells. Fearless. Durability is measured in hits.
Text.SUMMON_BONDS_ABILITIES: Cannot move or attack. Blocks passage. Durability is measured in hits. Its lifetime is limited by the spell.
